translations.web: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.
translations.bsb: and whoever picks up one of their carcasses must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean until evening.
translations.kjv: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
